newsitem.title: USA: Household files $500 mln debt, stock shelf.
newsitem.headline: Household files $500 mln debt, stock shelf.

text.p: Household International Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $500 million in debt securities and preferred and common stock and warrants.
When combined with a previous registration, Household will have a total offering of $550 million in debt and stock available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used to fund investments in or extensions to its subsidiaries and to reduce other outstanding debt, among other things, the company said in the filing.

Household International, based in Prospect Heights, Ill., is a holding company for various subsidiaries which operate in the financial services, manufacturing, transportation and merchandising industries.
